items.author: denise.albright
items.title: Linden Community Pantry stream
items.body: Hi Marcus! Thank you again for picking us. Confirming the details: stream Saturday November 21, 10am to 10pm. Donation page is lindenpantry.example/mrkz and it goes straight to us, nothing taken off. Through our wholesale partner every $1 gets us about 4 pounds of food. We're serving around 340 families a week right now and the shelves are the lowest I've seen before Thanksgiving. Canned and boxed food can also go in the blue bin by our side door, Saturdays 9 to 1. Anything you raise matters. - Denise
